messages:
Jin: Morning team, first week question 1 — where should I put my onboarding notes? I created a page in my personal space but not sure if it should live under People Ops or Product.
Avery: Hi Jin, welcome! Personal onboarding notes are fine in your private workspace. If something is useful org-wide, move it into the relevant team space (People Ops > Onboarding or Product > Playbooks) and add Owner + Tags. See the Devex hub for links: https://redwood.notion.so/devex-home
Jin: Thanks. If I turn my notes into a template, what's the process to get it in Team Templates?
Olivia: Short flow: duplicate your page, strip personal data, add template front-matter (Owner, Template Version, Status = draft), then file a quick PR in the docs repo with the Notion link and a 1-line explanation. Docs team will review and add it to Devex > Team Templates.
Lily: Small clarification: templates should NOT set retention. Leave Retention blank on templates; when a team publishes a page from a template they set the Retention and Review Date.
Jin: How do I request edit access to a team space? The Product Playbooks page is "View only" for me.
Devex Bot: Use `/doc-access request <notion-url>` in Slack or this form: https://forms.redwood.ai/doc-access. For faster help mention @Avery or @Olivia in #devex and paste the page URL + your email.
Avery: Granting edit now for Jin. Also style/convention notes: prefer kebab-case slugs (e.g., product-rfc-hyperdrive) and put team prefix in the title.
Jin: Sweet. Are there standard sections I should include for RFCs and Runbooks? I started a Runbook but forgot an Incident section.
Olivia: RFC template: Background, Assumptions, Proposal, Rollout Plan, Metrics, Rollback. Runbook must include Trigger, Step-by-step Mitigation, Quick Checks, Postmortem Link, and an Owner with contact. Use the template's checklist at the top to validate.
Lily: Also add the "Status" property (draft / published / archived) and set a Review Date. We use the Review Date + Owner for periodic audits.
Jin: Found the Publish checklist at the bottom of the Team Templates page. I moved my page to Product > Playbooks and updated Owner. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Avery: Welcome aboard again. If you want a quick content review for structure/links, DM me.
Jin: Will do, appreciate it!
